metas.name: Batman: The Animated Series
metas.description: Billionaire Bruce Wayne leads a double life as Batman, defending Gotham City from ruthless mobsters and costumed villains with help from Robin and a small circle of trusted allies.

metas.name: Superman: The Animated Series
metas.description: The last son of the planet Krypton protects his adoptive home of Earth as the greatest of the superheroes.

metas.name: Batman Beyond
metas.description: Fuelled by remorse and vengeance, a high schooler named Terry McGinnis revives the mantle of Batman and fights crime in a futuristic Gotham under the supervision of an elderly Bruce Wayne.

metas.name: Justice League
metas.description: Seven of the most formidable heroes form arguably the most powerful team ever.

metas.name: Justice League Unlimited
metas.description: A continuation of the Justice League animated series finds the original members of the team joined in their battle against crime and evil by dozens of other heroes from the DC comics universe.

metas.name: Young Justice
metas.description: Teenage superheroes strive to prove themselves as members of the Justice League.

metas.name: Spider-Man: The Animated Series
metas.description: When college student, Peter Parker, is bitten by a genetically altered spider, he gains Spider-like powers and must use his gifts to fight crime in New York City as the superhero, Spider-Man, whilst trying to have a normal persona...

metas.name: The Spectacular Spider-Man
metas.description: An animated television show that focuses on a sixteen-year-old Peter Parker, and the origins of Spider-Man.

metas.name: X-Men
metas.description: Follows a team of mutant superheroes called the X-Men, who fight against bigotry and hatred for being different while striving for justice and human acceptance in the Marvel comic book universe.

metas.name: X-Men '97
metas.description: A band of mutants use their uncanny gifts to protect a world that hates and fears them; they're challenged like never before, forced to face a dangerous and unexpected new future.

metas.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
metas.description: Four mutated turtles (Leonardo, Donatello, Raphael and Michelangelo), fight crime and eat pizza, whilst battling the evil Shredder and his foot robot ninjas as well as aliens, mad scientists, comedic gangsters and other weird muta...

metas.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
metas.description: Follows the adventures of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, with this iteration being based on the stories from the original mirage comic books.

metas.name: Transformers
metas.description: Two opposing factions of transforming alien robots engage in a battle that has the fate of Earth in the balance.

metas.name: Beast Wars: Transformers
metas.description: The Transformers' war continues in an older time, through a new generation. On pliocenic Earth, the heroic Maximals and the evil Predacons battle for survival against each other and against a violent planet.

metas.name: Pokémon
metas.description: On his 10th birthday, Ash starts his Pokémon journey with an unexpected Pikachu. He faces tough Gym battles but finds support in Brock, Misty, and new Pokémon companions Bulbasaur, Squirtle, and Charmander.

metas.name: Dragon Ball Z
metas.description: Goku, his son Gohan and their allies defend Earth from increasingly powerful enemies, pushing their extraordinary abilities to the limit in battles that reach far beyond the planet.

metas.name: Dragon Ball
metas.description: A young martial artist named Goku teams up with inventor Bulma and other quirky allies on a globe-trotting quest to find the seven Dragon Balls, mystical orbs that can summon a wish-granting dragon.

metas.name: Dragon Ball Super
metas.description: Six months after the defeat of Majin Buu, the mighty Saiyan Son Goku continues his quest on becoming stronger.

metas.name: Wolverine and the X-Men
metas.description: After an explosion at the school, the X-Men went their separate ways. But they must unite once again under the leadership of Wolverine to prevent an inevitable war while also dealing with present problems.

metas.name: The Avengers: Earth's Mightiest Heroes
metas.description: After 74 villains break out of prison, Marvel's most powerful superheroes team up to capture all of them, and also to defend the Earth from widespread threats.

metas.name: Iron Man: Armored Adventures
metas.description: A teenage Tony Stark battles evil with his revolutionary power armor technology.

metas.name: Static Shock
metas.description: In the city of Dakota, a teenage boy with electricity based powers, with the help of his inventive friend, fights crime as a superhero.

metas.name: Green Lantern: The Animated Series
metas.description: The further adventures of Hal Jordan and his comrades of the Green Lantern Corps.

metas.name: Invincible
metas.description: When 17-year-old Mark Grayson inherits superpowers, he becomes the superhero Invincible.

metas.name: Castlevania
metas.description: A vampire hunter fights to save a besieged city from an army of otherworldly creatures controlled by Dracula.

metas.name: Arcane
metas.description: Amid the stark discord of twin cities Piltover and Zaun, two sisters fight on rival sides of a war between magic technologies and clashing convictions.

metas.name: The Batman
metas.description: Billionaire Bruce Wayne fights crime and evil as the mysterious Batman.

metas.name: Batman: The Brave and the Bold
metas.description: An updated animated series centering on the Caped Crusader himself as he partners and deals with his fellow superheroes in the DC Comics universe.

metas.name: Legion of Super Heroes
metas.description: The adventures of a young Clark Kent, as Superman, during his time with a team of teenage superheroes in the far future.

metas.name: The Zeta Project
metas.description: A robot rebels against its creators, refusing to kill, and goes on the run.

metas.name: Fantastic Four: World's Greatest Heroes
metas.description: The adventures of the Marvel Universe's premiere superhero family.

metas.name: Jackie Chan Adventures
metas.description: Jackie Chan teams up with his 11-year-old niece, Jade, traveling the globe to locate a dozen magical talismans before the sinister Dark Hand does. Helping Jackie and Jade is Uncle, a cantankerous but wise antiquities expert.

metas.name: Men in Black: The Series
metas.description: The continuing adventures of Agents K and J as they deal with problems with extraterrestrials in New York City.

metas.name: Godzilla: The Series
metas.description: Dr. Nico Tatopoulos leads a team, known as H.E.A.T, to battle giant monsters with the help of Godzilla's only living offspring.

metas.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX
metas.description: A semi-spinoff of the popular Yu-Gi-Oh anime series, focusing on a boy named Jaden and his misadventures as a student at an esteemed Duel Monsters academy.

metas.name: Beyblade
metas.description: Four Beybladers and their genius friend travel the world as team 'Bladebreakers' to win a championship, realizing there's much more at stake on the go.

metas.name: Medabots
metas.description: 10-year-old Ikki Tenrio has always dreamed about becoming a top-ranked medafighter, and now that he has his own medabot he can finally pursue his dream.

metas.name: Shaman King
metas.description: SHAMAN KING follows the adventures of a 13-year-old shaman and his teammate a samurai warrior spirit, who traverse the world fighting evil spirits and misguided shamans on their journey to be the next Shaman King.

metas.name: Sonic X
metas.description: A slight malfunction causes Chaos Control, and sends Sonic the Hedgehog to Earth. While there, Sonic meets Chris Thorndyke, who aids at collecting the Chaos Emeralds, so Sonic and friends can go home.

metas.name: Sonic the Hedgehog
metas.description: In a post-apocalyptic and dystopian future, all life has been challenged by oppression and tyranny, as the evil Dr. Robotnik is on the wake of controlling Mobius.

metas.name: Swat Kats: The Radical Squadron
metas.description: In a world of anthropomorphic felines, two demoted fighter pilots battle evil as high flying masked vigilantes.

metas.name: Street Sharks
metas.description: Ripster, Jab, Streex and Slammu must protect their reputations and change the way they are being viewed in Fission City. They must fight Dr. Piranoid as well as finding their father once and for all...

metas.name: Biker Mice from Mars
metas.description: When three alien motorcycle riding mice are forced to leave their home planet of Mars thanks to the evil mining Plutarkians, they rebel against their enemies on planet Earth and the city of Chicago.

metas.name: Yu-Gi-Oh!
metas.description: Yugi Moto solves an Ancient Egyptian Puzzle and brings forth a dark and powerful alter ego. Whenever he and his friends are threatened by evil in Duel Monster Card Game, this alter ego breaks out to save them.

metas.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
metas.description: This Yu-Gi-Oh spinoff explores more serious themes. The story takes place in a dystopian future where Domino City has been divided into Neo Domino and the Satellite sector after a tragic incident. Satellite residents are looked do...

metas.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Zexal
metas.description: Yuma Tsukumo must team up with an ethereal being connected to an ancient relic left to him by his parents in order to collect 99 number cards. Doing so will restore the lost memories of this being, giving them the answers they seek.

metas.name: Digimon Adventure
metas.description: A group of young teens is unexpectedly sent to the mysterious Digital World and paired up with their own powerful, morphing monster called the Digimon. Together the entire group set out on an adventure to fight evil and save the w...

metas.name: Digimon Tamers
metas.description: An animated series based on the popular children's toy "Digimon", in which kids raise electronic monsters to fight against those raised by other kids.

metas.name: Digimon Data Squad
metas.description: We pick up with our heroes and the challenges faced by the members of DATS ("Digital Accident Tactics Squad"), an organization created to conceal the existence of the Digital World and Digimon from the rest of mankind.

metas.name: Beyblade: Metal Fusion
metas.description: The story of a teenager and his quest to become the best blader in the world.

metas.name: Dragon Ball GT
metas.description: After Goku is made a kid again by the Black Star Dragon Balls, he goes on a journey to get back to his old self.

metas.name: Dragon Ball Z Kai
metas.description: Goku is settled with his family and is living in peace. Unfortunately, his peaceful time is momentary as a visitor crashes into the planet claiming to be his brother.

metas.name: Naruto
metas.description: Naruto Uzumaki, a mischievous adolescent ninja, struggles as he searches for recognition and dreams of becoming the Hokage, the village's leader and strongest ninja.

metas.name: Naruto: Shippuden
metas.description: Naruto Uzumaki, is a loud, hyperactive, adolescent ninja who constantly searches for approval and recognition, as well as to become Hokage, who is acknowledged as the leader and strongest of all ninja in the village.

metas.name: One Piece
metas.description: A spirited young pirate sets sail with a growing crew in search of the legendary One Piece, facing dangerous seas and powerful rivals on his quest to become King of the Pirates.

metas.name: Bleach
metas.description: High school student Ichigo Kurosaki, who has the ability to see ghosts, gains soul reaper powers from Rukia Kuchiki and sets out to save the world from "Hollows".

metas.name: Inuyasha
metas.description: A teenage girl periodically travels back in time to feudal Japan to help a young half-demon recover the shards of a jewel of great power.

metas.name: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
metas.description: Two brothers search for a Philosopher's Stone after an attempt to revive their deceased mother goes awry and leaves them in damaged physical forms.

metas.name: Death Note
metas.description: An intelligent high school student goes on a secret crusade to eliminate criminals from the world after discovering a notebook capable of killing anyone whose name is written into it.

metas.name: Hunter X Hunter
metas.description: Gon Freecss aspires to become a Hunter, an exceptional being capable of greatness. With his friends and his potential, he seeks out his father, who left him when he was younger.

metas.name: Attack on Titan
metas.description: In a world where humanity shelters behind towering walls from man-eating Titans, a determined teen joins the elite Survey Corps to fight the giants and uncover the secrets of their origin.

metas.name: Soul Eater
metas.description: Set in the Shinigami technical school, the series revolves around a partnership between a weapon master and a human weapon. Trying to reach a ranking of "Death Scythe" they must collect the souls of 99 evil humans and 1 witch.

metas.name: Cowboy Bebop
metas.description: Intergalactic loners team up to track down fugitives and turn them in for cold hard cash.

metas.name: Samurai Champloo
metas.description: Fuu, a waitress who works in a teahouse, rescues two master swordsmen, Mugen and Jin, from their execution to help her find the "samurai who smells of sunflowers."

metas.name: Sailor Moon
metas.description: The magical action-adventures of a teenage girl who learns of her destiny as the legendary warrior Sailor Moon and must band together with the other Sailor Scouts to defend the Earth and Galaxy.

metas.name: Zatch Bell!
metas.description: Kiyo Takamine meets a momoto (demons from another world) boy zatch bell and set out to compete in the momoto games held every 1000 years to become their king.

metas.name: Bobobo-bo Bo-bobo
metas.description: The impossible adventures of Bobobo-bo Bo-bobo, a warrior who fights using his nose hairs to defeat an evil empire that wants to turn the human race bald.

metas.name: Kirby: Right Back at Ya!
metas.description: Kirby, a space-faring hero crashes his starship into the kingdom of Dream Land, where he stays in order to battle monsters summoned by the land's greedy and tyrannical King Dedede from evil intergalactic corporation Nightmare Ente...

metas.name: Monster Rancher
metas.description: Genki is a young teen boy who gets zapped into an alternate world called Monster Rancher (Monster Farm in the Japanese version) where he must stop the evil Moo which can only be done by reviving the Phoenix, along his journey he b...

metas.name: Chaotic
metas.description: A group of friends find a portal to Perim, another worldly dimension, where Chaotic, a popular card game, is real.

metas.name: Monsuno
metas.description: Monsuno hurtled through space eons before man existed. Upon burning through the planet's atmosphere and crashing to Earth, it brought chaos and the extinction of the dinosaurs. Then, it vanished. Now, Monsuno is back. Is the Earth...

metas.name: X-Men: Evolution
metas.description: This rendition of X-Men features Cyclops, Jean Grey, Rogue, Nightcrawler, Shadowcat and Spike as teenagers as they fight for a world that fears and hates them.

metas.name: Ultimate Spider-Man
metas.description: Spider-Man battles evil with a new team of teen colleagues and training from S.H.I.E.L.D.

metas.name: Spider-Man: The New Animated Series
metas.description: A young man with spider like abilities fights crime as a superhero in New York City while trying to have a normal personal life.

metas.name: Spider-Man Unlimited
metas.description: Spider-Man travels to Counter-Earth to rescue a Terran shuttle crew trapped there and discovers a tyrannical and warped version of his world.

metas.name: Spider-Man and His Amazing Friends
metas.description: Spider-Man battles crime in New York City with the help of Iceman and Firestar.

metas.name: Avengers Assemble
metas.description: The further adventures of the Marvel Universe's mightiest general membership superhero team.

metas.name: Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H.
metas.description: The Incredible Hulk teams up with Red Hulk, She-Hulk, Skaar, and Rick Jones aka A-Bomb to battle the forces of evil in front of cameras for Rick's web-based series to show the Hulk is more hero than monster.

metas.name: The Super Hero Squad Show
metas.description: Marvel's greatest heroes and evilest of villains battle it out in action packed, yet somewhat satirical alternate universe-style adventures.

metas.name: Fantastic Four: The Animated Series
metas.description: The adventures of Marvel Comic's greatest superhero team.

metas.name: Silver Surfer
metas.description: The adventures of the cosmic wanderer as he seeks his lost home after rebelling from his master.

metas.name: Beware the Batman
metas.description: Batman, a crime-fighting vigilante of Gotham City, goes up against the underworld.

metas.name: Transformers Prime
metas.description: In this new set of adventures the Autobots live on Earth and maintain their secret identity. They are joined by 3 teens as they battle the Decepticons.

metas.name: Transformers: Animated
metas.description: Transformers crash land on present day Earth and inadvertently cause a technological revolution. They wake up 50 years later in a world where robots are used in everyday life. StarScream arrives looking for their AllSpark.

metas.name: Transformers: Armada
metas.description: Autobots and Decepticons battle for control of the Mini-Cons, small Transformers that grant immense power to their masters. The fierce conflict rages on Earth, as both factions vie for dominance.

metas.name: Transformers: Energon
metas.description: Years after "Transformers: Armada", the Autobots continue to battle the Decepticons, but this time they must also prevent the resurrection of Unicron.

metas.name: Transformers: Cybertron
metas.description: The Autobots embark on a quest to locate mystical artifacts to save their homeworld of Cybertron from being sucked into a black hole. But the Decepticons want to get their hands on those artifacts too.

metas.name: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
metas.description: The most powerful man in the universe, He-Man, goes against the evil forces of Skeletor to save the planet Eternia and to protect the secrets of Castle Grayskull.

metas.name: Silverhawks
metas.description: A team of cyborgs protects Limbo from Mon Star and his gang.

metas.name: The Real Ghostbusters
metas.description: The continuing adventures of the staff of the ghost removal service.

metas.name: Astro Boy
metas.description: As long as trouble's brewing across the universe, the small but powerful robot, Astro Boy, will have adventures, assisted by his mentor, Dr. Elefun.

metas.name: Sonic Underground
metas.description: Sonic and his royal siblings seek to find their mother and defeat the tyrant, Robotnik.

metas.name: Sonic Boom
metas.description: Twenty-three years after the original "Sonic the Hedgehog" video game, fast, handsome, arrogant hero Sonic continues to fight his archnemesis, Dr. Eggman, aided by Tails, Knuckles, Amy, and new recruit Sticks.

metas.name: Loonatics Unleashed
metas.description: The futuristic descendants of the Looney Tunes characters become superheroes when the aftershock of an alien meteor grants them each with strange new powers.

metas.name: Voltron: Legendary Defender
metas.description: Five teenagers become the last line of defense for the galaxy in an intergalactic battle against the evil alien force led by King Zarkon.

metas.name: She-Ra and the Princesses of Power
metas.description: She-Ra, Princess of Power, leads a rebellion to free her land of Etheria from the monstrous invaders the Horde.

metas.name: Kipo and the Age of Wonderbeasts
metas.description: A girl explores the possibilities in a post-apocalyptic world.

metas.name: Wakfu
metas.description: Saving the world from an evil madman? Not a problem for this kid. Finding his birth parents? That's the real adventure!
